component.name: Resizable
component.description: Resizable panel layout with draggable dividers and keyboard support.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Layout container that owns resizable panels and handles.

slots.name: panel
slots.description: Content pane whose size is controlled by adjacent resize handles.

slots.name: handle
slots.description: Interactive target users drag or focus to resize panels.

slots.name: crossTarget
slots.description: Extra hit target used when nested handles meet across axes.

own.name: disable
own.description: Whether the resizable component is disabled.

own.name: handleAction
own.description:
Handle interaction behavior.
- `resize`: handle area follows divider resize interactions.
- `collapse`: handle click toggles the nearest collapsible panel.

own.name: id
own.description: Unique identifier for the resizable root.

own.name: intersection
own.description: Whether to use intersection-based handle sizing.

own.name: keyboardDelta
own.description: The amount to resize when using keyboard shortcuts.

own.name: onHandleKeyDown
own.type: ((context: { event: KeyboardEvent; handleIndex: number; sizes: number[]; }) => void) | undefined
own.description: Callback when a key is pressed on a handle.

own.name: onResize
own.description: Callback when any panel is resized.

own.name: onResizeEnd
own.description: Callback when a resize operation ends.

own.name: onResizeStart
own.description: Callback when a resize operation starts.

own.name: renderHandle
own.description:
Custom handle to render.
- `true`: render built-in handle.
- `JSX.Element`: render static custom handle content.
- `(state) => JSX.Element`: render dynamic content by handle state.

props.name: class
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the panel.

props.name: collapsible
props.description:
Whether the panel is collapsible.
This prop is reactive; toggling `true/false` can be used as a simple collapse signal.

props.name: collapsibleMin
props.description:
Size of the panel when collapsed.
Only works when `collapsible` is true.
- Use string as percent, like `20%`
- Use number as px, like `328`

props.name: content
props.description: Content to render inside the panel.

props.name: defaultSize
props.description:
Default size of the panel (uncontrolled).
- Use string as percent, like `20%`
- Use number as px, like `328`

props.name: max
props.description:
Maximum size of the panel.
- Use string as percent, like `20%`
- Use number as px, like `328`

props.name: min
props.description:
Minimum size of the panel.
- Use string as percent, like `20%`
- Use number as px, like `328`

props.name: onCollapse
props.description: Callback when the panel is collapsed.

props.name: onExpand
props.description: Callback when the panel is expanded.

props.name: onResize
props.description: Callback when the panel is resized.

props.name: size
props.description:
Current size of the panel (controlled).
- Use string as percent, like `20%`
- Use number as px, like `328`

props.name: style
props.description: Additional CSS styles for the panel.
